Messages.Author: Miguel Cortes
Messages.Body:
Here's the thing:

- When played as an action modifier during an action that costs blood,
does it reduce the action's cost, since it's payed when succesful
(after High Orun played)?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes.

(Also if Petaniqua takes a Daimoinon-requiring action and is blocked, but uses
Blessing of Durga Syn to steal Textbook Damnation from a blocking minion and
then taps the Ambulance to continue the action, the Textbook will reduce the
cost of the action.)

Messages.Author: D.J.
Messages.Body:


Wow. And Josh didn't even have time to *ask* the question before you
answered it. :-)

- D.J.

> Miguel Cortes wrote:
> > - When played as an action modifier during an action that costs blood,
> > does it reduce the action's cost, since it's payed when succesful
> > (after High Orun played)?
>
> Yes.
>

Really? Because in

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/44badd3b79a8a773

you said that High Orun does not apply to the action card because of
High Orun's "For the remainder of this action, cards" text.

I hope I'm wrong, because I'd like to see High Orun a little stronger
than it currently is, but I like consistent rulings.

Later,
~Rehlow

"to play", it works on the action card.
